body: ## Expected Behavior Workflow should pass ✅ unless there's something wrong with the branch (and as it's just a copy of `main`, there shouldn't be anything wrong with it), either by virtue of including an `if: github.repository_owner == 'temporalio'` or by using a `vars.HAS_UBUNTU_LATEST_8_CORES` guard for the runner. ## Actual Behavior ## Steps to Reproduce the Problem 1. Fork repository 1. Sync main branch ## Specifications [Existing system limits](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits#existing-system-limits) Limit category | Limit | Threshold | Description -- | -- | -- | -- Self-hosted | Job queue time | 24 hours | A job can be in the queue for 24 hours before it is automatically cancelled.
title: run-tests.yml workflow sets matrix.runs_on_override to a value that doesn't exist in most forks causing workflow to time out and fail after 24 hours
